# Treatment Codes

This folder contains the standardized Danish clinical procedure codes used within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease Database (DANIBD) to register and track treatments with biological and targeted synthetic drugs (BMSL). Each page details a specific pharmacological therapy—ranging from widely used anti-TNF biologics like infliximab and adalimumab to newer JAK inhibitors and S1P receptor modulators—documenting their clinical adoption, demographic usage disparities between adults and pediatric patients, and their role in evaluating national quality indicators for IBD care.

## Pages

- [[bohj18a1-behandling-med-infliximab|BOHJ18A1 - Behandling med infliximab]] — Tracks the most frequently administered anti-TNF biologic for both pediatric and adult IBD populations in Denmark.
- [[bohj18a3-behandling-med-adalimumab|BOHJ18A3 - Behandling med adalimumab]] — Registers the second most common anti-TNF biologic therapy, detailing its widespread usage across adult and pediatric cohorts.
- [[bohj18a4-behandling-med-golimumab|BOHJ18A4 - Behandling med golimumab]] — Documents an anti-TNF biologic applied exclusively to adult patients, representing a minor proportion of total BMSL therapies.
- [[bohj18b3-behandling-med-ustekinumab|BOHJ18B3 - Behandling med ustekinumab]] — Tracks an IL-12/23 inhibitor that shows a distinct demographic disparity, being heavily prescribed for adults but sparsely for children.
- [[bohj19h4-behandling-med-vedolizumab|BOHJ19H4 - Behandling med vedolizumab]] — Registers an α4β7 integrin inhibitor that ranks among the most prevalent BMSL treatments for adults and the second most common for children.
- [[bohj19n1-behandling-med-risankizumab|BOHJ19N1]] — Designates a newer biological therapy with currently limited clinical application among both pediatric and adult patients.
- [[bohj28d-behandling-med-tofacitinib|BOHJ28D - Behandling med tofacitinib]] — Records a JAK inhibitor that was the least utilized registered biologic and targeted synthetic therapy during the 2022–2023 period.
- [[bwhp107-behandling-med-upadacitinib|BWHP107]] — Tracks a JAK inhibitor with limited application across patient demographics during the 2024–2025 reporting period.
- [[bwhp141-behandling-med-filgotinib|BWHP141]] — Documents a newer JAK inhibitor that saw very limited clinical use, with zero registered pediatric treatments in recent audits.
- [[bwhp142-behandling-med-mirikizumab|BWHP142]] — Registers a newer IL-23 inhibitor with highly restricted clinical adoption and no pediatric treatments recorded in the 2025 report.
- [[bwhp143-behandling-med-ozanimod|BWHP143]] — Tracks an S1P receptor modulator with exceptionally low utilization, recording zero treatments for children and very few for adults.
- [[bwhp148-behandling-med-etrasimod|BWHP148]] — Documents a newer S1P receptor modulator reflecting early or limited uptake, with no pediatric registrations and minimal adult use.
